correctness.rationale: The conductance-normalized incidence matrix B=[R,sqrt(t)I] has full row rank. Direct inversion of the massive cycle Laplacian yields the stated explicit positive unimodal Green kernel. Projector blocks I-tG, sqrt(t)R^TG,tG have exactly the two stated absolute row sums; finite sign vectors attain both. The spectral diagonal strictly monotonic in t proves unique t_n, while exact finite-volume Green differences and a positive polynomial certificate prove the size cutoff. Rational incidence-matrix reconstruction for sizes 3 through 12 and four rational square-root weights passed 486 assertions; these checks are supplementary rather than substitutes for the all-parameter proof. The critical Taylor coefficient 64/9 and rational n=6 witness were independently recomputed.

value.rationale: Weighted graph-gradient least squares is naturally l2 nonexpansive but can amplify bounded individual measurements. Wheel graphs distinguish hub and rim observations, motivating both edge types. The exact norm provides tight finite sign-attained robustness guarantees, identifies the unique weight crossover, proves the first six-rim violation of factor two, and establishes the exact universal-size weight-one threshold and sharp global factor three. These are motivated structural boundaries rather than arbitrary numerical slices.
